HediffDef.label: respiratory failure
HediffDef.description: Breathing has stopped. Restore the airway or functioning lungs immediately. Without restored oxygen delivery, cerebral hypoxia accumulates and this failure becomes fatal in approximately three game hours.

HediffDef.label: acute liver failure
HediffDef.description: No functioning liver tissue remains. A functioning replacement can resolve this failure. Without it, failure progresses toward death over approximately one game day.

HediffDef.label: acute renal failure
HediffDef.description: No functioning kidney tissue remains. One functioning kidney or a suitable replacement can resolve this failure. Untreated complete failure becomes fatal over approximately five game days.

HediffDef.label: blood filtration failure
HediffDef.description: Blood filtration has stopped without an identified complete liver or kidney failure. Restore the underlying filtration capacity. Untreated failure becomes fatal over approximately one game day.

HediffDef.label: metabolic failure
HediffDef.description: Metabolism has stopped. Restore the affected organs or capacity. Untreated failure becomes fatal over approximately three game days.

HediffDef.label: coma
HediffDef.description: Consciousness has fallen to zero, although the brain is structurally present. Treat the cause. This condition resolves when consciousness returns; persistent untreated coma becomes fatal over approximately five game days. Coma alone does not imply oxygen deprivation.
